# PARA Social Research API

> Agent-first documentation for registering LinkedIn and Reddit research topics, running collection through the paired Chrome extension, and consuming immutable relevant-post batches.

Use this file as the compact documentation index. Use `llms-full.txt` only when
the complete documentation corpus fits the available context window.

## Agent directives

- Read Agent quickstart and Agent handoff before making requests.
- Treat the live OpenAPI 3.1 document as the canonical endpoint and schema contract.
- Read API credentials from environment variables. Never print, persist, or place them in prompts, logs, URLs, or artifacts.
- Reconcile registrations by `external_id` before creating one. Never invent resource IDs.
- Persist one stable `Idempotency-Key` per intended mutation and reuse it only for the identical operation.
- Creating a registration is side-effect free for collection. Activation is the boundary that enables extension work and daily delivery.
- Collection is asynchronous and extension-only. Do not scrape LinkedIn or Reddit directly and do not launch a substitute browser collector.
- Treat an empty `posts` array as a successful completed batch.
- Verify webhook HMACs against the exact raw body before parsing JSON.
- Require explicit operator approval before archive, secret rotation, API-key rotation or revocation, and delivery replay.
- Reddit reply drafts and LinkedIn comment drafts are advisory. This public API never authorizes posting, commenting, voting, or other participation actions.
- On `401` or `403`, stop and request corrected credentials or scopes. On `404`, do not infer that another owner's resource exists.
- On `429`, honor `Retry-After`. Retry `5xx` and transport failures with bounded backoff. Do not blindly retry other `4xx` responses.

## Start here

- [Agent quickstart](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/agents/quickstart.md): Deterministic bootstrap, request policy, and completion conditions.
- [Agent handoff](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/agents/handoff.md): Operator input contract, approvals, checkpoints, and final report format.
- [Agent manifest](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/agent-manifest.json): Machine-readable origins, contracts, capabilities, scopes, events, and safety rules.
- [Authentication](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/authentication.md): Bearer credentials, scopes, rotation, and secret handling.
- [Errors, idempotency, and limits](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/guides/errors-idempotency-rate-limits.md): Retry decisions and stable mutation keys.

## LinkedIn workflow

- [LinkedIn agent workflow](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/agents/linkedin.md): Reconcile, create, activate, run, monitor, and consume final LinkedIn results.
- [LinkedIn quickstart](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/quickstart.md): Copyable API requests.
- [LinkedIn registrations](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/guides/registrations.md): Lifecycle and matching revisions.
- [LinkedIn matching](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/guides/matching-relevance.md): Expanded post collection, Parallel author enrichment, reranking, and drafts.
- [LinkedIn results](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/guides/result-polling.md): Immutable batch polling.
- [LinkedIn webhooks](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/guides/webhooks.md): Event payload, signature, retries, and replay.

## Reddit workflow

- [Reddit agent workflow](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/agents/reddit.md): Reconcile, create, activate, run, monitor, and consume final Reddit results.
- [Reddit quickstart](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/reddit/quickstart.md): Copyable API requests.
- [Reddit registrations](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/reddit/registrations.md): Sources, capture settings, lifecycle, revisions, and owner isolation.
- [Reddit matching](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/reddit/matching.md): Initial relevance, extension-only public author context, reranking, and advisory drafts.
- [Reddit results](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/reddit/results.md): Full posts, comments, provenance, and immutable batches.
- [Reddit webhooks](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.site/reddit/webhooks.md): Event payload, signature, retries, and replay.
